message:
The robot stops itself short even if commands stop arriving, so out-of-sight driving cannot run away. Manager, the link-loss watchdog stop simulation (E32) gives 0.308 m total with 0.5 s loss versus 0.0625 m brake-only in the tip-over and stopping check (E23) at 0.5 m per s capped speed, about one shoe length, which holds the fail-safe rule.

Blind position stays bounded because wheel odometry plus Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU), meaning motion sensors for rotation and acceleration, is reset on the collection bin fiducial. Mobility and Deployable Chassis Lead, the blind localization drift simulation (E33) bounds error to 0.100 to 0.150 m with a 5.00 m fiducial reset versus metres of growth without a fix, about a hand width, so Excavation and Regolith Handling Lead keeps trench and pour aligned.

Operating direction stays fixed to the same view so the operator never mirrors left and right. The leading end always digs and the trailing end always dumps, seen by forward drive plus downward dig plus mast views in the blind-operation layout (E34), and the fiducial final-align error budget (E58) gives 0.030 to 0.040 m pose error at 1.00 to 2.00 m range with a 0.150 m creep correction at 0.100 m per s in 1.50 s, about a finger width at arm's length, so Power Structure and Integration Lead keeps antennas and cameras on that same front-rear reference.

Position: ready, because stop distance, bounded drift, and fixed leading-dig plus trailing-dump direction all survive with margin and need no redesign.
